title: Geometric certificates for canonical open comparisons in arbitrary degree
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ an inverse diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $c$ a cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $F_i$ be abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] on $D_i$, with inverse-image transitions $\varphi_f:D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^*F_i\to F_j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] satisfying the canonical identity and composition equations. Let $G:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(c.pt_{\acute et})$ have isomorphisms $eG_i:G_i\cong c_i^*F_i$ and arrows conjugate to the inverse-image composition comparison followed by $c_j^*\varphi_f$. Let $L$ be a cocone on $G$. Fix a scheme $X$, $i_0\in I$, $g_0:D_{i_0}\to X$ and $W\subseteq X$ open. Put $J=I_{\ge i_0}$, $W_j=(D(j\to i_0);g_0)^{-1}W$ and $W_L=(c_{i_0};g_0)^{-1}W$. The restricted transition $W_k\to W_j$ and projection $W_L\to W_j$ are the restrictions of the original maps. Their coefficient maps are the inverse-image composition comparisons followed by the restrictions of $\varphi_f$ or $(eG_j)^{-1};L_j$, respectively. Write $T_W^n(f)$ and $\lambda_W^n(j)$ for the resulting maps on cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback], namely pullback followed by the cohomology map of that coefficient map. Assume that $c$ is limiting, that all $D_i$ are quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], all transitions are affine, and $L$ is a colimit. Suppose $O\subseteq X$ is open, $W\le O$ is quasi-compact, and $D_{i_0}\cong O$ identifies $g_0$ with the inclusion of $O$. Fix $n\ge0$ and a predicate $P$ on schemes with $P(W)$. For any supplied diagram $K$, isomorphisms $e_j$ and cocone legs $\iota$ satisfying the arrow and leg formulas above, the map $\operatorname{colim}K\to H^n(W_L,L.pt|_{W_L})$ has a StageCohomologyComparison certificate for $P$ [def-weil-pbc-stage-cohomology-comparison]. No isomorphism or cohomology continuity is asserted.

source.place: Tag 09YQ (theorem-colimit), coherent-system construction and restriction; Tag 01F7, canonical pullback and cohomology functoriality. The finite direct-sum application is Tag 0A50 (lemma-mayer-vietoris).

proof.text: Identify the tail opposite with Over(op i0), and restrict the diagram and limiting cone to inverse-image opens. The restricted cone is limiting, transitions are affine, and compactness of W pulls back along affine maps. Open subschemes inherit quasi-separatedness. The least restricted stage is isomorphic to W.

Restrict the coefficient system using inverse-image composition. Finality of the directed tail preserves the reindexed sheaf colimit and inverse image preserves that colimit as a left adjoint. The concrete maps and supplied object identifications satisfy the system constructor formulas; apply it and transport through the limit-open and coefficient isomorphisms.

theorem etale_limit_open_comparison_certificate_degree
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (O W : X.Opens) (hW : IsCompact (W : Set X)) (hWO : W ≤ O)
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L)
    (i₀ : I) (e : D.obj (op i₀) ≅ O.toScheme)
    (n : ℕ) (allowed : Scheme.{u} → Prop) (hallowed : allowed W.toScheme)
    (K : Set.Ici i₀ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eK : ∀ j : Set.Ici i₀, K.obj j ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (tailStageOpen D (e.hom ≫ O.ι) W j).ι).obj (F j.val)) n))
    (hK : ∀ (j k : Set.Ici i₀) (f : j ⟶ k), K.map f =
      (eK j).hom ≫ tailOpenCohomologyMapDegree D (e.hom ≫ O.ι) W F φ n f ≫ (eK k).inv)
    (ι : K ⟶ (Functor.const (Set.Ici i₀)).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ (e.hom ≫ O.ι)) ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj L.pt) n)))
    (hι : ∀ j, ι.app j =
      (eK j).hom ≫ tailOpenCohomologyLegDegree D c (e.hom ≫ O.ι) W F G eG L n j) :
    StageCohomologyComparison allowed (colimit.desc K (Cocone.mk _ ι))
